_comment: Legacy-shaped installer seed. Only medium is used for fresh installs.
The installer writes {model} to ~/.pi/workflows/subagent-model.json, not this file.
Existing model-tiers.json files migrate their medium choice on first workflow use.
Use /workflow-model to choose the single subagent model from pinned models.
Reinstall preserves both existing choices and legacy files.
To reset to the repository default, remove subagent-model.json and model-tiers.json
from ~/.pi/workflows, then reinstall. Back up those files first if rollback is needed.
